message.isekai_mahou.combat_lock.hint: Press %s to lock on · the mouse wheel switches target
message.isekai_mahou.guard.hint: Hold %s to block · press it right as the hit lands to parry
command.isekai_mahou.combat_lock.info: Locked target (server): %s · spells aim at the target: %s · "!!!" warnings: %s
command.isekai_mahou.combat_lock.warn: Test "!!!" warning sent (from the nearest monster, if any).
command.isekai_mahou.guard.info: Blocking: %s · hits blocked: %s · parries: %s · parry window: %s ticks · reduction: %s%% · held item can block: %s
command.isekai_mahou.guard.hit: Training hit of %s damage in %s ticks: two beeps, then the hit. Hold block, or press it right on time to parry.
Everyone can block by holding the key with a weapon or staff in hand, and parry by pressing it right as the hit lands.
isekai_mahou.configuration.guardDamageRe: 0.5 = a block absorbs half the damage. Magic and explosions absorb less (60% of it).
isekai_mahou.configuration.parryWindowTi: Time after pressing block during which a hit is parried. 6 = 0.3 s. 0 = no parry.
isekai_mahou.configuration.parryStunTick: How long a parried attacker stays stunned. Bosses take half.
isekai_mahou.configuration.guardExhausti: Hunger spent on each blocked hit (plus 10% of the damage). 4.0 = 1 hunger point.
isekai_mahou.configuration.guardBreakDam: A hit this big or bigger breaks your guard for 2 s. Heavy hits ask for a parry or a dodge.
isekai_mahou.configuration.parryFlash.to: A short flash on the screen edges when you parry a hit.
isekai_mahou.configuration.guardHintSeen: Set by the game after showing the hint. Untick to see it again.
isekai_mahou.configuration.threatWarning: Warns when a common monster is about to land a heavy hit or attacks from behind.
isekai_mahou.configuration.lockSpellAim: Spells aim at the locked target
Spells from a player with a locked target fly exactly towards it.
isekai_mahou.configuration.lockShoulderC: With a locked target in third person, the camera moves to the shoulder and frames you and the target.
isekai_mahou.configuration.lockLeftShoul: The locked camera sits over the left shoulder instead of the right one.
isekai_mahou.configuration.lockScrollSwi: With a locked target, the mouse wheel switches target instead of the hotbar item.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showThreatWar: A short "!!!" over the monster or on the screen edge when a heavy hit or a back attack is coming.
isekai_mahou.configuration.threatWarning: A soft sound together with the warning.
Set by the game after showing the hint. Untick to see it again.
